title: アップライトピアノ
description: 交流室・学校の音楽室・小規模舞台に置く無銘のアップライトピアノ。52個の白鍵と36個の黒鍵、厚い鍵盤台、固定開放した鍵盤蓋と譜面台、三本のペダル、側脚、裏の響板色パネルと補強柱を造形。椅子・楽譜は付属せず、鍵やペダルは本体に含む一式1点です。音声、鍵盤アクション、調律や実楽器の性能は実装・検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.498 × 1.216 × 0.786 m、14,816三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An unbranded upright-piano prop for community rooms, school music rooms and small stages. It includes 52 white and 36 black keys, thick keybed, fixed raised fallboard/music rest, three pedals, side feet, rear soundboard-colored panel and braces. Stool and sheet music are absent; keys and pedals belong to one piano assembly. Audio, key action, tuning and real-instrument performance are not implemented or validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.498 × 1.216 × 0.786 m; 14,816 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
